description: What lampstand init plants for the constitution's layers L1 to L6, apart from principles. Each entry copies template to destination, only when the destination is missing; when names a house.toml key and the value it must hold. A {{name}} placeholder is replaced by the operator's answer, verbatim. L1 (purpose) and the ask-first lines are answers written to house.toml ([purpose] text, [charter] ask_first), so no file is planted for them.
